verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of p593 (XIII-11) prints '3.5 THE REPORT DESCRIPTION ENTRY' and the subheadings 3.5.1 Function, 3.5.2 General Format, 3.5.3 Syntax Rules and 3.5.4 General Rules as numbered section headings, in the same style as other clauses. page-593.md carries all five as plain paragraphs with no '#' marker.
